practical_allocation_threshold.meaning: A serving-cost-bearing candidate below this exploratory gain normally does not justify more training. This is a spending rule, not scientific significance. Both-fold direction, whole-chain uncertainty and native runtime inform the final decision.

promotion: No automatic promotion. Positive ensemble evidence must survive native parity/runtime; use fresh training seed if budget permits. All available folds reused; CI excludes training-seed/adaptive-selection/hidden-shift uncertainty.
negative: Archive tested recipe and stop its training; do not infer no historical information remains.
authorization: Prior autonomous competition research request; no push or submission.
